title: RAS-Pathway Mutation Profiles and Clinical Outcomes Among Patients With Colorectal Cancer.
snippet: Somatic alterations in the RAS-RAF-MAPK and PI3K pathways are key in colorectal cancer (CRC), yet their distribution, co-occurrence patterns, and clinical significance remain incompletely defined. title: Experimental and Pharmacoinformatic Studies Reveal Allium cepa L. Extract-Mediated Modulation of Hepatitis B Virus Associated Inflammatory Pathways via Quercetin Glucoside Derivatives.
